title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: employer entry size and verification basis by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's employer-size entry basis: the minimum and maximum number of employees an employer may enroll under each partnership tier, the minimum total monthly contract value the tier requires, and how the employer's headcount for that tier is verified.

| Tier | Minimum enrolled employees | Maximum enrolled employees | Minimum total monthly contract value | Headcount verification basis | Nonprofit documentation required | Government contract reference required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 2 | 24 | $44.00 | Self-attested | No | No |
| Small Business Partner | 25 | 99 | $475.00 | Self-attested | No | No |
| Mid-Market Partner | 100 | 499 | $1600.00 | Documented | No | No |
| Enterprise Partner | 500 | Unlimited (a value of zero means no maximum applies) | $6500.00 | Documented | No | No |
| Municipal Partner | 50 | Unlimited (a value of zero means no maximum applies) | $750.00 | Documented | No | Yes |
| Nonprofit Partner | 10 | Unlimited (a value of zero means no maximum applies) | $140.00 | Documented | Yes | No |

An employer must enroll at least the tier's minimum number of employees, and, where the tier sets a maximum other than zero, may not enroll more than that maximum, to hold that partnership tier. A tier whose verification basis reads 'Documented' has the employer's headcount established from supporting records rather than from the employer's own unverified statement; the Startup Partner and Small Business Partner tiers instead accept the employer's own attestation of headcount.
